rows.text: The LDP reports that the election of its 21st president was notified (告示) on 8 September 2006, 臼井日出男・総裁選挙管理委員長 declaring the notice at 11:00, and that the member and Diet-member ballots would be counted on the 20th.

locator.section: date line 【平成１８年 ９月 ８日】; headline 総裁選挙が告示 安倍、谷垣、麻生の３氏が立候補; first and second paragraphs

rows.text: The same report says 安倍晋三, 谷垣禎一 and 麻生太郎 filed their candidacies that day.
The same report describes the election as held on the expiry of the term of 小泉純一郎総裁 (小泉純一郎総裁の任期満了に伴う).
